name: repeated_refrain
description: A refrain repeats three times verbatim, so its trigrams are not unique anchors; the gaps must be resolved by the surrounding unique text and LCS.
segments: The road went on and on beneath the hills.
And still the wind said nothing at all.
Past the mill and over the bridge the travellers walked in silence.
And still the wind said nothing at all.
Evening came with orange light across the fields of barley.
And still the wind said nothing at all.
Only the river answered, low and patient, as it had for a thousand years.
